card.name: Small words in accretion disc astronomy
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, in, at, to, are, some) just before an expected astronomy term, in passages on active galactic nuclei, black holes and accretion discs.

modes.label: Article or preposition before disc
modes.description: A short word like an, in or at right before accretion or a black-hole location.
modes.example: cold material close to a black hole forms<< an>> accretion disc.

modes.label: Linking word in AGN description
modes.description: Verbs or adverbs in sentences about AGN emission, host galaxies or jets.
modes.example: The host galaxies of Seyferts<< are>> usually spiral or irregular galaxies.

card.writes: It seems to prepare words that begin with acc (as in accretion) and other astrophysics or proper-name starts.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in astronomy text about black holes and the glowing discs around them.
